Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game character concept turnaround for an art direction website
Input images: Image 1 is a style, layout, scale, and rendering reference only. Create a different original character while matching its three-view sheet presentation and arcade concept-art finish.
Primary request: Create Lin Si, true identity Zhu Yunxi, the second playable protagonist from a story set aboard Zheng He's early Ming fleet. He appears as an impoverished traveling scholar in Malacca, but is calm, learned, mechanically skilled, and capable with early firearms.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly plain warm eggshell neutral background
Subject: the same young Chinese man shown three times. Slender and quietly alert, around 5.2 heads tall, narrow intelligent face, straight brows, composed expression. Black hair tied into a low compact knot under a simple charcoal scholar's cloth cap, with one short tie tail. Dusty blue-gray cross-collar calf-length travel coat split at the sides for movement, dark umber edging and elbow patches, muted parchment inner robe, narrow rust-ochre sash, deep charcoal trousers, pale gray cloth gaiters, dark cloth shoes. A compact rectangular brown leather repair satchel on his wearer's right hip with two small brass tools visible, and a short historically plausible early-Ming cast-bronze hand cannon with wooden stock secured horizontally across the back waist by the sash, visible consistently in side and back views. No royal insignia. Clothes are well mended and travel-worn, suggesting a scholar hiding status.
Composition/framing: wide landscape 3:2 character turnaround sheet with exactly three equally spaced complete full-body views, aligned crown and soles. Left is exact orthographic front, middle exact left profile, right exact orthographic back. Natural standing pose with arms slightly away from torso, feet apart, no perspective action.
Style/medium: original 1990s arcade pixel-art character concept, matching Image 1's crisp black-ink contours, punchy cel-shaded block colors, restrained high-density pixel clusters, slightly enlarged hands and head, detailed but readable folds, polished game artbook plate
Color palette: slate blue, charcoal, parchment, rust ochre, aged brown leather, muted bronze
Constraints: same clothing, proportions, cap, satchel, sash, shoes, and equipment across all three views; complete body visible; neutral stance; no labels, no text, no borders, no watermark; no modern objects; no copied game characters or recognizable costume designs
Avoid: Q-version proportions, anime school uniform, modern rifle, fantasy armor, royal robes, dramatic pose, perspective distortion, extra props
